title: United Nuclear supplies DHS and FBI training
summary: Bob Lazar tells of United Nuclear supplies DHS and FBI training, about 1999-present at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they they train uh Department of Homeland Security, FBI.

plain: Bob Lazar, whose company United Nuclear sells scientific supplies, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that the business has been involved with federal training since about 1999. He says the people they work with train the Department of Homeland Security, the US agency that protects the country at home, and the FBI, the US federal police. If true, it would mean his small supply business sits close to government security work.
